description: Healer. A throw-heal loop of Loa's Brew and Potion Toss over a Cauldron of Ingredients, Spices and Bases that spread mitigation across the party instead of spending it on one big button.
_source_note: Built from reference/coa_sidekick/SPEC_witch-doctor__brewing.txt and the 'brewing' tree in reference/coa_sidekick/talents/witch-doctor.json. CoA: 'Closest to Preservation Evoker, mechanically rather than by vibe ... Its group mitigation is distributed across the Cauldron Bases and Ingredients ... That parallels Preservation's spread-the-mitigation approach rather than one big raid button.' Stat priority is SPIRIT > Spell Power > Crit > Haste > Intellect, so Spirit Healer and Mixologist carry the tree the way Spell Power usually would. The one thing this spec genuinely lacks in CoA and lacks here too is hard single-target CC: 'Where it diverges from Evoker is hard single-target CC, of which it has none of its own.'

nodes.name: Presence of the Loa
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your critical strike chance by 4%'. Crit sits third in this spec's stat priority, above Haste.

nodes.name: Potent Mixes
nodes.description: Increases your healing power by 2% and reduces the threat your spells generate by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your healing done by 4% and reduces the threat generated by your spells by -15%' at 2 ranks. healing_power_pct takes percentage POINTS here, so 2.0 is +2% a rank - the opposite convention to the fractional threat key beside it in the same dict.

nodes.name: Mojo Addiction
nodes.description: Increases your maximum Mana by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your maximum mana by 5%' at 2 ranks.

nodes.name: Plentiful Potions
nodes.description: Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cost of your Loa's Brew and Hexbreak by -10%'. NOTE the sign: talented_cost does cost * (1 - pct), so a POSITIVE value is the discount. Authoring this negative is the mistake that once made a whole spec's heals more expensive than its tooltips promised.

nodes.name: Spirit Healer
nodes.description: Grants healing power equal to 3% of your Spirit per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases healing power by 25% of Spirit and increases spell critical strike chance by 10% of Spirit.' Spirit is this spec's primary stat, so this is the node the whole tree is built around. A real stat conversion.

nodes.name: Brewmaster
nodes.description: Increases the healing of Loa's Brew by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cast time of Loa's Brew by 0.25 sec' at 2 ranks. Cast time does not exist in a turn engine, so the node pays out as throughput on the same spell.

nodes.name: Potion Boss
nodes.description: Increases the healing of Potion Toss by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the effectiveness of Potion Toss and your tossed Ingredients by 20%.'

nodes.name: Mixologist
nodes.description: Increases your Spirit by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA ships Mixologist with no tooltip at all ('see builder tooltip'). Placed as the Spirit node its name and its no-gate slot imply, which is also what Spirit Healer above needs to be worth taking.

nodes.name: Disciple of Sseratus
nodes.description: Increases all healing you do by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the bonus healing scaling of Loa's Brew and Spirit in a Bottle by 15%.'

nodes.name: Fresh Ingredients
nodes.description: Increases the healing of Ingredient: Jungle Shrooms by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the healing of your Jungle Shrooms from your Cauldron by 15%' at 2 ranks.

nodes.name: Splash On 'Em
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Potion Toss by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Effective healing done by Loa's Brew and Mojo Beam reduce the cooldown of Potion Toss and Splash Potion by -1 sec.' A heal-driven cooldown chip has no hook, so it is a flat reduction - which is why Potion Toss ships on a 3-turn cooldown rather than 1.

nodes.name: Sen'jin's Presence
nodes.description: Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Potion Toss and Spirit in a Bottle now reduce the cast time of your next 2 Loa's Brews by -20%'. A conditional cast-time cut becomes a flat cost cut - the resource the turn engine actually charges you.

nodes.name: Jungle Secrets
nodes.description: Your heals spill 10% of their value onto your other allies, per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'When you heal with Loa's Brew your Effigies will now heal an additional ally within 20 yds for 35% of the healing done, prioritizing allies with low health.' splash_heal is the engine's own spread-a-fraction-of-this-heal payload.

nodes.name: Doctor of the Jungle
nodes.description: Increases the healing of Mojo Beam by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Jungle Shrooms used from your Cauldron now ticks -3 sec faster' and 'Jungle Booms ... ticks -0.5 sec faster' - faster ticks are more healing per window, and Mojo Beam is the channel they are tuned around.

nodes.name: Spice: Earthroot
nodes.description: Grants 5 healing power and 3 Spirit per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Infuse your Cauldron with Spice: Earthbloom. Increases effectiveness of all Cauldron effects and Ingredients by 30%.' A multiplier on a category of abilities has no key, so the Spice pays flat healing power - and Spirit, which this spec converts into more.

nodes.name: Spice: Peacebloom
nodes.description: Reduces the duration of stuns used against you by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the duration of roots, stuns, and snares against allies within 40 yds by -25%.' The stun half is a real key, read in StatusEffectMixin; it applies to you only, because stun_duration_reduction_pct is read through get_talent_effect and a talent has no party reach.

nodes.name: Touch of the Spirits
nodes.description: Your damaging spells leave the target taking 2% more damage and dealing 4% less, per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Spirit In a Bottle causes the enemies to take 3% more damage and deal -3% less damage for 15 seconds.' This is the node CoA means by 'you pressure while you protect'. The two keys take DIFFERENT units inside a status effect: damage_taken_pct raw, damage_dealt_pct in percentage points.

nodes.name: It's Da Mojo
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 1% and your spell critical strike damage by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Allows your Mojo Beam to critically heal.' A per-ability crit permission has no flag, so the node carries the crit it was granting access to.

nodes.name: Master of Concoctions
nodes.description: Your Ingredients last 1 turn longer per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the duration of Ingredients by 20% and causes allies affected by Jungle Shrooms to heal for 5% of the damage they deal.' The duration half covers all three Ingredients; the leech half is already Bloodthistle's own proc and is not paid twice.

nodes.name: Mojo Wave
nodes.description: Your heals spill a further 12% of their value onto your other allies, per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Healing with Mojo Beam now heals up to 3 of the lowest health nearby allies within 20 yds for 75% of the healing done.' Stacks with Jungle Secrets, which is how CoA's own free passives stack with its picks.

nodes.name: Unstable Concoction
nodes.description: Increases the healing you do to allies below 35% health by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Potion Toss now applies Unstable Concoction ... Using Loa's Brew or Spirit in a Bottle on the target will trigger an explosion of mojo around the target, healing nearby allies'. A two-cast combo is not expressible, so the node becomes the emergency throughput it was for. low_health_healing_pct is read recipient-side in the heal path.

nodes.name: Loa's Blessing
nodes.description: Your heals leave the target receiving 8% more healing per rank for three turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Healing done by Loa's Brew now applies a random empowerment to the target ally.' A random pick from a table is not something a proc can express, so the empowerment is the one that always helps a healer: the next heal lands harder.

nodes.name: Master Mixologist
nodes.description: You stop measuring. +10% healing done and +4% healing power.
nodes._source: Capstone. CoA: 'Master Mixologist is the big amplify window', held 'as the group heal-burst and wipe-prevention amplify window for a burst mechanic the group needs to survive'. The spec is rated Dun B / Raid C with a 'moderate throughput ceiling', so the capstone raises the ceiling rather than adding another button.
